title: Record the normalized COPY floor
body:
## Summary
- The pairing rank is at least the sum of the two dimensions minus the ambient dimension, and the nine-bit dot product is nondegenerate.
- For normalized ranks 8+s and 8+t with s and t in {0,1}, Sylvester's bound forces COPY at least 72. The orthogonal frame has eight terms of cost 9.
- Partial, no new kappa. This records that floor. It does not exhaust the character pairs.
